Container.Name: ByeDPI
Container.Author: ne0ark
Container.Description: ByeDPI is a local SOCKS5 proxy that defeats DPI-based site blocking (Russia/CIS). Set your system proxy to HostIP:ProxyPort (default 127.0.0.1:1080).

Config.Name: Proxy Port
Config.Description: SOCKS5 proxy listen port. Set browser/system proxy to HostIP:Port (default 127.0.0.1:1080).

Config.Name: Bind IP
Config.Description: IP to bind proxy. Use 0.0.0.0 for all interfaces, 127.0.0.1 for localhost only.

Variable.Name: BIND_IP
Variable.Description: IP to bind the proxy (0.0.0.0 = all, 127.0.0.1 = localhost only)

Config.Name: DPI Bypass Mode
Config.Description: DPI circumvention method. Try --disorder 1 first (Linux), add --fake -1 for harder blocks, use --auto=torst for auto mode.

Variable.Name: MAX_CONNECTIONS
Variable.Description: Maximum number of concurrent client connections (default: 512)

Config.Name: TTL
Config.Description: TTL for fake/out-of-order packets. 1-255. Lower = blocked by DPI. Higher = may reach server. Default: 8

Variable.Name: FAKE_TTL
Variable.Description: TTL for fake/out-of-order packets. Range 1-255. Default: 8

Config.Name: Extra Arguments
Config.Description: Additional ciadpi command-line arguments. See https://github.com/hufrea/byedpi
